title: Exposure to per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in North Carolina homes: results from the indoor PFAS assessment (IPA) campaign
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1654-1670
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00525B, Paper
Naomi Y. Chang, Clara M. A. Eichler, Elaine A. Cohen Hubal, Jason D. Surratt, Glenn C. Morrison, Barbara J. Turpin
Per and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are ubiquitous in the indoor environment, resulting in indoor exposure. Inhalation and ingestion dominate.
